Elaine Park: Heads up — saw a production drop in prefix cache hit-rate on us-east-1 around 10:12. Hit-rate fell from ~58% to ~19% after the kernel selection change last night.
Ravi Patel: ugh. any idea which change? kernel selector commit id?
Elaine Park: looks correlated to 'kernel-tie-breaker' that prefers fused attention kernels for seq_len > 512. Rolling back locally restores hit-rate to ~56%.
Samir Khan: that seems like an odd coupling. how would kernel choice change cache keys?
Elaine Park: traces show different kv-store footprint: new kernels chunk prompt into 2048B spans, previously 1024B — we use span-aligned hashing in the cache key so key entropy changed.
Tiago Morales: so deterministic keying + chunk size = different key space => warm misses. makes sense.
Samir Khan: can we avoid changing chunking behavior at runtime? or make cache key use normalized prefix hashing independent of kernel spans?
Ravi Patel: proposal: add a canonicalization layer that normalizes prompt prefix by content hashing (`sha256(prefix)`) instead of span offsets. That should decouple kernel internals from cache keys.
Samir Khan: nice. quick mitigation: add an opt-in header for clients to request "stable-key" semantics while we roll the fix. header: `X-Redwood-Cache: stable-key=1`
Elaine Park: also observed a miss-storm on retries: when SDK retries during streaming reconnect, it sends retry with `cache-opt: opt-in` lost. Need SDK fix.
Tiago Morales: SDK PR incoming — preserve cache headers across retry redirect & reconnect flows.
Ravi Patel: also want a short experiment: A/B routing 10% traffic to canonicalization prototype. need telemetry: per-prefix hit-rate, per-model, kernel-version tag.
Elaine Park: created experiment ticket: INF-3742. @Samir can you add a profiler dump and the kernel selection table to the ticket?
Samir Khan: posted profiler snippet: ```
# profiler summary
kernel: fused-attn-v2 -> avg latency 11.2ms
kernel: fused-attn-v1 -> avg latency 12.8ms
kv-cache hit-rate before: 58.1%
kv-cache hit-rate after: 18.9%
miss latency p95 increased by 35ms
```
Tiago Morales: thanks. next steps: (1) SDK header preserve PR, (2) canonicalization shim, (3) small canary rollback option for kernel-tie-breaker. I can handle (1), Samir take (2)?
Samir Khan: yes. timeline: PRs this week, canary next Tue. I'll add design notes to INF-3742.
deploy-bot: deployment of `runtime:kernel-tie-breaker @prod` successful at 03:18. :rocket:
Elaine Park: noted. let's track in the incident board and ping @oncall if hit-rate drops again.
Ravi Patel: +1. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
